name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
cues: Rest your forearms on the bench with palms down
Let your hands hang past the edge
Lift the backs of your hands toward the ceiling

qa.note: Family review 2026-10-01 rated minor. repaired: see repair report | skeptic after repair: The pronated hands look open. In the wrist close-up (qa/out/F8/refute-v2-close-hands/figure-709-wrist_R.png, t=0.375 to 0.75), the fingers lie straight and flat over the handle and dumbbell head instead of wrapping around it. This shows at 480 px in the front sheet (refute-v2-front/figure-709-front.png, t=0.5 to 0.75): the hands read as flat palms pressing down on the dumbbells, not a closed overhand grip. The earlier fixes hold: the kneecap is inside the mat (side sheet, every phase), and the dumbbell now hangs clear of the pad at full flexion.
